clauses.title: Scope –Requirements for double
clauses.text: 1. Scope -Requirements for double flanged cast iron pipes of Class B only up to dn 750 for pressure main lines of water, gas and sewage manufactured by horizontal castings in sand moulds.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Test
clauses.text: 3. Hydrostatic Test — Shall not show any sign of leakage, sweating or other defects when pressure indicated below is applied for 15 s. HYDROSTATIC TEST PRESSURE FOR HORIZONTALLY CAST PIPES Nominal Diameter Test Suggested DN Pressure Maximum Hydraulic Working Pressure including Surge (1) (2) (3) MPa MPa Upto and including 300 mm 2.5 1.2 Over 300 mm and upto and 2.0 1.0 including 600 mm Over 600 mm 1.5 0.6

clauses.title: Sizes
clauses.text: 4. Sizes 2.1 Nominal diameter— DN : 80, 100, 125, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 600, 700 and 750 mm. Working Lengths —   2.75 and 3 m. 2.2     Nominal Thickness — 10.0, 10.5, 11.1, 11.7,  12.8, 14.0, 15.2, 16.3, 17.5, 18.7, 19.8, 22.2, 24.5 and 25.6 corresponding to nominal diameters 80 to 750 mm respectively.

clauses.title: On External Diameter
clauses.text: 5.1 On External Diameter Dimension       Nominal Diameter Tolerance DN mm External diameter All diameters (4.5+0.0015 DN) of  barrel (DE)

clauses.title: On Thickness
clauses.text: 5.2 On Thickness Dimension Tolerance Wall thickness - (1+0.05e) Flange thickness (2+0.05b) Where e  = thickness of wall in mm, and b  =  thickness of flange in mm.

clauses.title: On length
clauses.text: 5.3 On length —     10 mm Deviation from a straight line— Less than 0.00125 l where l is the length.

clauses.title: Coating shall not be
clauses.text: 6.1 Coating shall not be applied to any pipe unless its surfaces are clean, dry and free from rust.

clauses.title: In all cases where
clauses.text: 6.2 In all cases where the coating material has a tar or similar base, it shall be smooth and tenacious and hard enough not to flow when exposed to a temperature of 65°C but not so brittle at a temperature of  0°C as to chip off when scribed lightly with a penknife. SUMMARY OF IS  7181 : 1986 HORIZONTALLY CAST IRON DOUBLE FLANGED PIPES FOR  WATER, GAS AND SEWAGE (First Revision) ± ± ±
